purpose: Record externally inspected historical cartographic artifacts without promoting them to canonical geometry.

records.title: 14. yüzyıl başında Anadolu Türk Beylikleri haritası
records.rights: CC BY-NC-ND 4.0 as stated by SALT Research
records.reason: The artifact is explicitly described as a beginning-of-14th-century map, not a date-specific 1326 boundary source. The stated no-derivatives condition also prevents treating transformed/georeferenced derivatives as an unrestricted production source.

records.title: Harita 2. Eşrefoğulları Beyliği Sınırları (Alperen, 2001)
records.description: The published figure distinguishes the beylik centre, settlements, an approximate widest extent and territories temporarily attached. The paper also reports the broad regional extent in narrative form.
records.pageEvidence: Harita 2 is directly inspectable on printed p.211 of Tekkanat & Yavuz 2017; this is the secondary reproduction page, not the original Alperen 2001 page.

records.title: Beylicats d’Anatolie vers 1330-tr.svg
records.rights: Wikimedia Commons page states source references to published historical atlases; current record is treated as reference-only until source provenance and transformation rights are independently reviewed.
records.reason: The map is approximately 1330, not scenario-date 1326-04-07. It may provide regional cross-checks but cannot be relabelled as a 1326 boundary artifact.

records.title: Beyşehir ve Tarihi
records.reason: The underlying work is identified, but this review did not locate a clearly reusable downloadable binary of the 2001 book or an independently retained original map artifact. It therefore cannot supply image bytes, SHA-256, or transformation rights for georeferencing.
records.physicalAvailability: current second-hand catalogues show multiple listed copies

records.title: Eşrefoğulları Beyliği'nin konumu.png
records.author: Kılıç46
records.reason: The artifact is openly licensed for adaptation, but it is a modern cartographic rendering of the beylik location rather than a date-specific 1326-04-07 boundary artifact. Its geographic construction/source methodology is not independently established in the current review, so it may support visual/cartographic cross-checks but cannot be treated as canonical boundary geometry.

records.title: Ek 1: Eşrefoğulları Beyliğinin Yayıldığı Coğrafi Alan
records.sourceWork: Nebahat Aydın, Eşrefoğulları Beyliğinin İlmi ve Kültürel Faaliyetleri
records.reason: The annex provides an independent regional depiction of Eşrefoğulları, but the current evidence does not establish the map's underlying cartographic source, exact temporal interpretation for 1326-04-07, transformation rights for the embedded figure, or a project-controlled map-image SHA-256. It is therefore cross-source evidence only.

records.title: Eşref Oğulları tarihi: Beyşehir klavuzu [sic]
records.sourceWork: Memduh Yavuz, Eşref Oğulları Tarihi: Beyşehir Kılavuzu
records.reason: The public Google Books record confirms a digitized copy exists, identifies Indiana University as the original source, and exposes partial contents/common-term metadata, but the current public interface does not expose page images and reports no eBook available. A secondary used-book listing describes the item as having one plan, which corroborates a visual/plan component but does not identify its subject, date, scale, or cartographic source. The fold-out/plan therefore cannot be classified as a boundary map or linked to Aydın (2005) Annex 1.

secondaryCorroboration.description: Secondary used-book listing: “Fotoğraf Ve Şekilli 88 Sayfa Metin + 1 Plan”
